name: AISStream
tagline: Real-time AIS vessel tracking over free WebSocket
description: Real-time Automatic Identification System (AIS) ship tracking via WebSocket. Free API key signup for live vessel positions, static data, and message subscriptions filtered by bounding box or MMSI.

auth.details: API key in WebSocket subscription message JSON field "APIKey" after connect; free self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free tier available (limits not fully verified from pricing page)

use_cases: stream live vessel positions in a geographic bounding box
track a specific ship by MMSI over WebSocket
build a real-time maritime traffic map dashboard
filter AIS message types for position and static vessel data
